name: SEO Signal Research
description_zh: 查询关键词搜索量、CPC、竞争度、相关词、Google 搜索结果和趋势数据；需求不明确时先确认要查哪类数据，避免不必要的完整检索。
description_en: Retrieve keyword search volume, CPC, competition, related keywords, Google search results, and trend data; confirm the needed data type when the request is unclear to avoid unnecessary full retrieval.
